roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Core App Experience

bullets: Building systems that make the app experience better for 58M+ daily users
Balancing investing for the long-term with launches that make the experience better today
Working with PMs across the company to understand their needs, while still holding a high bar for the overall app experience
Bringing clarity and impact to an ambiguous problem space

roles.title: VP of Product, Growth and Monetization

bullets: Own DAUs and revenue, Duolingo’s two hero metrics, and deliver both against forecast.
Manage the pillar leads who run Growth and Monetization, an org of roughly 20 PMs and our largest.
Coach and develop senior product leaders, and raise the bar for product talent across the company.
Partner with Engineering and Design leadership to make clear tradeoffs and ship quickly.
Build world-class product operating mechanisms: Clear north star metrics, planning and review rituals, and rigorous A/B testing.
Own product strategy and execution for a new growth team, from identifying opportunities to shipping and iterating on solutions
Drive the team’s roadmap across high-impact workstreams, with DAUs as the north star
Lead product features through their full lifecycle: ideation, prioritization, specification, development, launch, analysis, and iteration
Work closely with engineers, data scientists, ML/AI partners, product writers, and designers to create more retentive experiences ￼ ￼
Improve core team metrics such as retention (short and long term), L7, and relevant feature adoption / usage
Be responsible for improving the learning experience through delightful and impactful products
Drive product features through their entire creative cycle: ideation, specification, development, release, analysis, and iteration
Establish the strategy for your focus area, and build alignment across product teams, cross-functional partners, and the leadership team
Perform qualitative and quantitative research to explore and validate feature ideas
Work with engineers to help guide feature development
Build and optimize user experiences that drive conversion, retention, and long-term value
Identify high-impact opportunities through data, research, and experimentation
Partner with design to create simple, intuitive, and compelling user experiences
Work cross-functionally with marketing, data science, and engineering to deliver end-to-end solutions
Define strategy and prioritize across multiple growth and monetization initiatives
